desc:
Welcome to +1 Speed One Piece Escape ⚡🏴‍☠️
Sail through dangerous stages inspired by the world of pirates and become faster with every run! 🌊💨

🧠 How to Play:
- Every run boosts your SPEED! ⚡
- Dodge deadly obstacles and make it through each stage to win! 🏃‍♂️💨
- Unlock powerful pirates and legendary characters! 🔥
- Rebirth to unlock new perks and boosts! 🧬
- Train on the treadmill or run around the map to get even faster! 💪

⚙️ Features:
- Smooth and responsive movement system 🌀
- Progressive speed scaling for intense gameplay ⚡
- Unlockable characters & powerful upgrades 🔥
- One Piece inspired worlds and stages 🏴‍☠️

If you're built different and love speed… SMASH THAT LIKE ❤️❤️❤️
